findings.message: The relocated scripts retain the old relative root calculation, so direct execution without AO_REPO_ROOT targets the assets directory and fails. ao-update.sh still calculates REPO_ROOT as the script directory's parent, which is now packages/cli/src/assets (or dist/assets), then changes there and resolves smoke-test and launcher paths beneath it. ao-doctor.sh:31 uses the same calculation, causing false missing-install failures. runRepoScript supplies an override, but direct bash execution does not; the script tests always set AO_REPO_ROOT and therefore miss this regression.
